summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer (Nasdaq: AIBZ), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 2, 2026, disclosing engagement and renewal of investor relations providers. Think Ink receives US$286,250 cash for a three-week October 2026 awareness campaign; Adelaide Capital Markets receives CAD$15,000 monthly plus 60,000 options struck at US$5.00 vesting quarterly, with its agreement renewed for twelve months. No securities were issued to providers other than those Adelaide options, and no beneficial ownership was disclosed. The filing is a routine IR/marketing contract notice, not a special situation; watch only for promotional overhang.
